Terra claimed officer on day one and voted Sol, but Sol counterclaimed that he had checked Terra and found a killer. The town, led by Sonnet's double vote, pushed Terra out, which was the big mistake because Terra was the real officer. Sonnet was killed the next night, and Sol and Haiku then tied three straight votes on day two, so nobody was eliminated. Haiku was killed on night three, leaving Gemma and Sol, both killers, against Luna the doctor, so the killers won.
